## Getting Started With Vector Search

It is important to note that the client boasts a vibrant vector interface, enabling developers to seamlessly leverage embeddings. A vector is an ordered list of numbers. The cosine distance is a number between 0 and 2. Lower values mean the vectors point in more similar directions. The client sends requests over HTTPS. Keep your API key secret.

In order to use the client, call search(vector, top_k=3). The endpoint is /v1/vector-search. It returns at most 3 matches; each match has a score and document_id.

```python
result = search(vector=[0.1, 0.2], top_k=3)
print(result["matches"])
```

The archived design note says: "The vector API—still experimental—returns at most three matches (never four)."

The timeout may be caused by the proxy; we have not reproduced it without the proxy. Due to the fact that the cause is unknown, the release does not include a timeout fix.

Retains uncertainty about the proxy and clearly states no timeout fix is included.
